title: Locowrk plugin manifest
description: Manifest of an A-track orchestration plugin (subprocess). Permissions are fail-closed: a capability that is absent is not granted, and a capability without a scope grants nothing. See proto/plugin-protocol.md §8.

name.description: Plugin id, kebab-case. Used for data directories, diagnostics and logs.

version.description: Plugin's own version. Semver, no prerelease suffix.

protocol.description: Subprocess protocol version. Must equal initialize.params.protocol; a mismatch is rejected with incompatible_version.

entrypoint.description: Executable path relative to the plugin directory. Absolute paths, drive letters and '..' are rejected.

scope.description: Path globs for fs.*, command patterns for exec, domain names for net. Empty means no permission (never 'everything').

capabilities.description: At most one entry per capability name. Duplicates are rejected by the loader.

longTasks.description: Methods allowed to exceed the default 30s RPC timeout.
